title: Meta$^2$: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents
title_zh: Meta²：为长程智能体在线框架演化预计算可复用知识

paragraphs.en: Meta²离线学习可复用的框架演化知识，在线应用后刷新两大长程智能体基准成绩。 Harness optimization improves long-horizon agents by refining the prompts, tools, memory, and hooks around a frozen model. Offline methods can learn from completed trajectories, but deploy one shared harness that may overfit training tasks and cannot react to evidence revealed during a new run. Online evolution can adapt before, during, or after one run through an evolver, but may have to reason about every intervention from scratch or rely on verifier feedback that is usually unavailable at test time. We introduce Meta$^2$, which moves offline optimization one level up: rather than optimizing a shared harness, it learns reusable knowledge for harness evolution and applies it within each task online. Offline, Meta$^2$ learns a textual Meta-Skill $M$ by contrasting training rollouts of the same task agent under three configurations: without an evolver, with an evolver guided by the current version of $M$, and with an evolver given privileged verifier information available only in training. Contrasts in trajectories and outcomes are aggregated across tasks to refine $M$ into reusable guidance on when and how to evolve, when to leave the harness unchanged, and which interventions to avoid. Online, an evolver combines the frozen $M$ with emerging trajectory evidence to decide whether to KEEP the harness unchanged or EVOLVE it through a task-local edit. Each edit applies to the rest of the same run without resetting its environment or progress. Thus, evolution guidance transfers across tasks while harness edits remain task-local, and held-out verifier feedback is never available to the evolver. On two long-horizon benchmarks, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE 1.1, Meta$^2$ achieves the highest performance among evaluated methods with GPT-5.6-Terra, reaching 81.00% and 44.44%, respectively. Ablations support the value of contrastive evolution guidance and keeping online harness edits task-local.
paragraphs.zh: Meta²离线学习可复用的框架演化知识，在线应用后刷新两大长程智能体基准成绩。Harness优化通过精炼冻结模型周围的提示词、工具、记忆和钩子来提升长程智能体。 离线方法可以从已完成的轨迹中学习，但只能部署一个共享的框架，该框架可能过拟合训练任务，且无法对新一轮运行中显现的证据做出反应。 在线演化可以通过演化器在单次运行之前、之中或之后进行自适应，但可能必须从头推理每一次干预，或依赖在测试时通常无法获得的验证器反馈。 我们提出Meta$^2$，它将离线优化提升一个层次：不是优化共享框架，而是学习可复用的框架演化知识，并在每个任务内在线应用这些知识。 离线阶段，Meta$^2$通过对比同一任务智能体在三种配置下的训练轨迹来学习文本形式的元技能$M$：不使用演化器、使用由$M$当前版本引导的演化器、以及使用被赋予仅训练时才可获得的特权验证器信息的演化器。 跨任务汇总轨迹和结果上的对比，将$M$提炼为可复用的指导，说明何时以及如何演化、何时保持框架不变、以及应避免哪些干预。 在线阶段，演化器将冻结的$M$与新出现的轨迹证据相结合，决定是保持（KEEP）框架不变，还是通过任务局部的编辑来演化（EVOLVE）它。 每次编辑都适用于同一运行的剩余部分，而不会重置其环境或进度。 因此，演化指导可以跨任务迁移，而框架编辑保持任务局部，且留出的验证器反馈从不提供给演化器。 在两个长程基准Terminal-Bench 2.1和DeepSWE 1.1上，Meta$^2$在采用GPT-5.6-Terra的受评估方法中取得最高性能，分别达到81.00%和44.44%。 消融实验支持对比性演化指导的价值，以及保持在线框架编辑任务局部性的价值。
